# Upstream Coverage — apex-azure-deploy

Source: `jonathan-vella/apex@c209d8bb765681aa21dce5d3cd2a3b080dad8d5e`; imported 37 files, including the main skill.

All useful technical areas are retained. Main-skill routing and approval prose are rewritten for the kernel;
references preserve provider recipes, command diagnostics, SDK patterns and examples. Scripts/YAML are non-executable
Markdown source examples. Legacy plan/status markers, orchestration roles and generic auto-deploy authority are not
ported as runtime contracts. Mutations are context only; planned purpose-bound delivery (DECISION-036, CP-26 to CP-30)
is not available until implemented and qualified.
